arStrings.szText:
Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} gains a specialized {c_important}{u}Execute{/u}{/c} effect for non-Boss enemies with {c_random}[{SF_2}*100|%|]{/c} or less Life:

{if:SF_9}The {c_important}Oracular Rune{/c} from {c_important}Celestial Surge{/c} {c_important}{u}Executes{/u}{/c} non-Boss enemies. Successful {c_important}{u}Executions{/u}{/c} reduce your Cooldowns by {c_number}[{SF_15}||]{/c} seconds.{/if}{if:SF_10}The {c_important}Disintegrate{/c} beam {c_important}{u}Executes{/u}{/c} non-Boss enemies with {c_random}[{SF_2}*100|%|]{/c} or less Life. This threshold is doubled for non-Elite enemies.{/if}{if:SF_11}The {c_important}Mana Blast{/c} from {c_important}Propulsion{/c} {c_important}{u}Executes{/u}{/c} non-Boss enemies. Successful {c_important}{u}Executions{/u}{/c} grant {c_random}[{SF_18} * 100|%+|]{/c} Movement Speed for {c_number}{SF_19}{/c} seconds.{/if}{if:SF_12}{c_important}Astral Pillar{/c} will launch additional waves towards {c_important}{u}Executable{/u}{/c} non-Boss enemies to {c_important}{u}Execute{/u}{/c} them.{/if}{if:SF_13}{c_important}Cosmic Anomaly{/c} will {c_important}{u}Execute{/u}{/c} non-Boss enemies with its implosion. Successful {c_important}{u}Executions{/u}{/c} increase your Attack Speed by {c_number}[{SF_16}*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_17}||]{/c} seconds.{/if}{if:SF_14}{c_red}Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} is not activated.{/if}
Earn by completing Horadric Strongrooms after acquiring "Legendary Arcana" from Horadric Knowledge.
